surface: The dropdown editor: opening it on a cell, arrowing through its fixed choices, and Enter committing the highlighted one.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the cell holding `Al`: a text field with the combobox role over a list of Alpha, Alfa and Alto. The dropdown never filters, and it highlights Alpha on open (the tree golden marks that option selected). Unsure whether a reader names the highlighted option on open, so only the text and the role are required.
Alpha is already highlighted when the editor opens, so the first ArrowDown reaches the second choice, Alfa. The focus stays in the text field and aria-activedescendant names the option.
Enter commits Alto and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves), so the cell announced is the next row's, which holds `Al`.
ArrowUp returns to the edited cell, which now holds the committed choice, `Alto`.
